name: Sanbiki no Kobuta to Mayoeru Ko Ookami
original_name: ３匹の子ぶたと迷える子おおかみ
source:
Warimashi Inc.'s easygoing wolf salesman, Robin, is always at the bottom of the sales charts.

In order to somehow win a contract for a water purifier, she goes to the three little pigs!

[From [url=https://kumakumaf.itch.io/sanbiki]itch.io[/url]]
